_note: PLAN P3 QoL colorblind palette (GameSettings.ColorblindPalette, Client ColorblindFilter): an exact-colour remap applied to the finished frame when the option is on; colours not listed are drawn unchanged, and with the option off the frame is not touched. Targets follow the Okabe-Ito set so the status/HP and map colours stay apart under deuteranopia and protanopia (checked with the Brettel/Vienot simulation in ColorblindFilterTests). The map fallback's grass shades (R varies, G 90, B 45) become a lightness ramp of bluish green.
